# Starting a study: the effect of the old level-up button, plus the chapter counter of the window.
DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy = {
	add_country_modifier = {
		name = DA_Tech_Researching_Metallurgy
		duration = -1
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes }
			} hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy_1 value = 1 } }
			subtract_variable = {
				which = DA_Metallurgy_exp
				value = 1000
			}
			DA_SCH_study_begin = { school = 1 chapters = 1 months = 12 }
			country_event = {
				id = DA_Tech_Tree_event.500
				days = 365
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes
				NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes }
			} hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy_1 value = 1 } }
			subtract_variable = {
				which = DA_Metallurgy_exp
				value = 2500
			}
			DA_SCH_study_begin = { school = 1 chapters = 2 months = 12 }
			country_event = {
				id = DA_Tech_Tree_event.501
				days = 365
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes
				NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes }
			} hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy_1 value = 1 } }
			subtract_variable = {
				which = DA_Metallurgy_exp
				value = 5000
			}
			DA_SCH_study_begin = { school = 1 chapters = 3 months = 8 }
			country_event = {
				id = DA_Tech_Tree_event.503
				days = 240
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes
				NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes }
			}
			subtract_variable = {
				which = DA_Metallurgy_exp
				value = 10000
			}
			DA_SCH_study_begin = { school = 1 chapters = 4 months = 8 }
			country_event = {
				id = DA_Tech_Tree_event.506
				days = 240
			}
		} } } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_SCH_start_study_Metallurgy_1 value = 0 } }
	}

	hidden_effect = { DA_SCH_refresh = yes }
}

DA_SCH_study_begin = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_school value = $school$ }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_ch value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_chn value = $chapters$ }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_len value = $months$ }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_left value = $months$ }
		DA_SCH_slot_percent = yes
	}
}
# Called by the study events in front of the next chapter (the patch marks them "DA_SCH chapter").
DA_SCH_next_chapter = {
	hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_ch value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_len value = $months$ }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_left value = $months$ }
		DA_SCH_slot_percent = yes
	}
}
DA_SCH_study_done = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_school value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_ch value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_left value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_slot_pct value = 0 }
	}
}
# Bar of the shared slot: ((chapter - 1) + months done / months of the chapter) / chapters, in percent.
DA_SCH_slot_percent = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_len value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp which = DA_SCH_st_len }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp which = DA_SCH_st_left }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp which = DA_SCH_st_len }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_slot_pct which = DA_SCH_st_ch }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_SCH_slot_pct value = 1 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_slot_pct which = DA_SCH_tmp }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_chn value = 1 } }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_SCH_slot_pct which = DA_SCH_st_chn }
	}
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_SCH_slot_pct value = 100 }
}

# Everything the window shows that is not a flag: computed when it opens, when a tab changes and once a month
# while it is open.
DA_SCH_refresh = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		DA_SR_refresh_multipliers = yes   # the school report (DA_School_Reports_effects.txt)
		# Metallurgy
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_xp_1 which = DA_Metallurgy_exp }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_need_1 value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_need_1 value = 1000 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_need_1 value = 2500 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_need_1 value = 5000 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_need_1 value = 10000 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_miss_1 which = DA_SCH_need_1 }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_SCH_miss_1 which = DA_SCH_xp_1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_need_1 value = 1 } }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_SCH_xp_1 which = DA_SCH_need_1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_SCH_xp_1 value = 100 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_xp_1 value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_xp_1 value = 100 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_xp_1 value = 100 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_0 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_3 value = 0 }
		every_owned_province = {
			if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_0 } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_0 value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_1 } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_1 value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_2 } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_2 value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_3 } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_b_1_3 value = 1 } } }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_0 } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_1 } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_2 } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_3 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_1 } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_2 } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_3 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_2 } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_3 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 which = DA_SCH_b_1_3 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 200 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 300 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 400 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 500 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 25 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 20 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 15 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Metallurgy_4 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_bu_1 value = 10 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SCH_rep_1 value = 100 } }

DA_SCH_monthly = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_left value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_SCH_st_left value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_left value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_left value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_report_left value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_SCH_report_left value = 1 } }
	DA_SCH_slot_percent = yes
	DA_SCH_potion_percent = yes
	if = { limit = { DA_has_main_tech_interface_open = yes } DA_SCH_refresh = yes }
}

# Potion Crafter timeline: phase 1 the toxic months, phase 2 the active years (set by the potion events).
DA_SCH_potion_phase = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_phase value = $phase$ }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_len value = $months$ }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_left value = $months$ }
		DA_SCH_potion_percent = yes
	}
}
DA_SCH_potion_percent = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_tox value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_act value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_len value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp which = DA_SCH_pot_len }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp which = DA_SCH_pot_left }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_SCH_tmp which = DA_SCH_pot_len }
	}
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_SCH_pot_phase value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_tox which = DA_SCH_tmp } }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_SCH_pot_phase value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_tox value = 100 } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_pot_act which = DA_SCH_tmp } }
}
# The material picked in the selection event, by the slot being filled (DA_alchemy_slot counts the filled ones).
DA_SCH_ingredient = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_slot value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_1 value = $n$ } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_slot value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_2 value = $n$ } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_slot value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_3 value = $n$ } }
		else = { set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_4 value = $n$ } }
	}
}
DA_SCH_ingredients_clear = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_3 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_ing_4 value = 0 }
	}
}
# The part picked in a designer event, by unit and part; a rune goes to the next socket (DA_Runes_Slots_occupied).
DA_SCH_pick = { hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_SCH_pk_$unit$_$part$_$token$ } }
DA_SCH_pick_rune = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_Runes_Slots_occupied_$unit$ value = 1 } } } set_country_flag = DA_SCH_pk_$unit$_rune1_$token$ }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_Runes_Slots_occupied_$unit$ value = 2 } } } set_country_flag = DA_SCH_pk_$unit$_rune2_$token$ }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_Runes_Slots_occupied_$unit$ value = 3 } } } set_country_flag = DA_SCH_pk_$unit$_rune3_$token$ }
		else = { set_country_flag = DA_SCH_pk_$unit$_rune4_$token$ }
	}
}
# A new design of a class (DA_initialize_metallurgy_variables) forgets its parts.
DA_SCH_pick_clear = { hidden_effect = { DA_SCH_pick_clear_$unit$ = yes } }

# Tabs. Every tab clears the others, sets its own flag and refreshes the window.
DA_SCH_show_overview = {
	DA_tech_interface_close_tabs_effect = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_SCH_tab_overview
	DA_SCH_refresh = yes
}
DA_SCH_show_met = {
	DA_tech_interface_close_tabs_effect = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_Technology_interface_on_main
	DA_SCH_alloy_slots = yes
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = DA_Metallurgy_events.0 } }
	DA_SCH_refresh = yes
}
DA_SCH_show_arc = {
	DA_tech_interface_close_tabs_effect = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_Technology_interface_on_Arcane_Arts
	DA_SCH_refresh = yes
}
DA_SCH_show_mec = {
	DA_tech_interface_close_tabs_effect = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_Technology_interface_on_Mechanics
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_trade_and_production_on has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_tax_and_religion_on has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_education_and_government_on has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_infrastructure_on has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_army_on has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_navy_on has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_technology_on } } }
		set_country_flag = DA_mechanics_trade_and_production_on
	}
	DA_SCH_refresh = yes
}
DA_SCH_show_alc = {
	DA_tech_interface_close_tabs_effect = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_Technology_interface_on_Alchemy
	DA_SCH_refresh = yes
}
DA_SCH_show_med = {
	DA_tech_interface_close_tabs_effect = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_Technology_interface_on_Medicine
	DA_SCH_refresh = yes
}
DA_SCH_alloy_slots = {
	hidden_effect = {
		export_to_variable = { value = modifier:DA_fake_alloy_common_slot_adder variable_name = DA_alloy_common_slots }
		export_to_variable = { value = modifier:DA_fake_alloy_rare_slot_adder variable_name = DA_alloy_rare_slots }
		export_to_variable = { value = modifier:DA_fake_alloy_legendary_slot_adder variable_name = DA_alloy_legendary_slots }
	}
}

# S4 (doc 83): the Mechanics page. The realm's innovativeness for the header; the selected upgrade always one of
# the category shown (its first upgrade otherwise). Run by DA_SCH_refresh and by the category buttons.
DA_SCH_mec_numbers = {
	hidden_effect = {
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_SCH_innov value = trigger_value:innovativeness }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_trade_and_production_on OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 1 } } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 21 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_tax_and_religion_on OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 21 } } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 41 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 21 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_education_and_government_on OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 41 } } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 61 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 41 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_infrastructure_on OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 61 } } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 81 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 61 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_army_on OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 81 } } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 101 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 81 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_navy_on OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 101 } } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 121 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 101 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_technology_on OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 121 } } check_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 141 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_mec_sel value = 121 } }
	}
}
